title: Project Learning Record
description: Schema for learnings/<codename>.yaml files. Rust agov is the current AGF v2 operator validator surface; historical v1.x Python validators are legacy reference material. Cross-artefact invariants (append-only supersession, confidence corroboration thresholds) live in schemas/invariants.yaml.

codename.description: Mandatory pseudonym, never the real project name. Anonymisation policy enforced separately by validate-infosec.

id.description: Stable learning identifier. Historical records may use L###; bare timestamp IDs may exist as historical references but new records use YYYYMMDDThhmmssZ-<4-char-random>. Preserve existing IDs when updating historical records.

category.description: Conventional values per learnings/_template.yaml: gap | overkill | validation | adaptation | tension. Rust agov validates the current AGF v2 learning record surface.

scope.description: Conventional values: framework | project. Validator does not currently enforce.

type.description: Conventional values across the corpus: prevented_loss | enabled_revenue | cost_overhead | neutral | positive. Validator does not enforce the enum.

severity.description: Conventional values: critical | significant | minor | informational. Validator does not enforce the enum.

superseded_by.description: Optional forward-pointer to a later entry's title in this same file. Validated structurally by validate_learnings (must point forward).

sentinel_ack.description: Acknowledgements for findings the infosec-sentinel validator flagged. Per-finding shape enforced by validate-infosec, not this schema.
